#rom debug
#save after-first-dungeon
# Every DX newcomer leads into Tiny Woods and attacks a staged foe; shots catch the attack animation.
# Generated by tools/dxtest/gen_newcomer_attack_test.py.
log --- Riolu #424
mash START sMainMenu 4 != 0 3000
write *gRecruitedPokemonRef+3704 2 424
wait 60
press UP
press A
wait 30
press A
wait 30
press UP
press UP
wait 10
expect *sDxWarp+0xB0 4 == 2
press A
wait 40
expect *sDxWarp+0xB0 4 == 1
press A
mash A gDungeon 4 != 0 1800
wait 600
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoId 2 == 424
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoHP 2 999
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves 1 1
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!2 2 154
write ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!4 1 20
write gDxTestStageTypes 1 255
write gDxTestStageHP 2 0
write gDxTestStageFoe 1 1
write gDxTestStageFoe+1 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate 1 0
write gDxTestStageMate+1 1 0
write gDxTestStage 1 1
waitfor gDxTestStage 1 == 0 900
wait 20
shot riolu_0_stand
press A
wait 6
shot riolu_1_attack
wait 8
shot riolu_2_attack
wait 8
shot riolu_3_attack
wait 120
expect ***gDungeon+@gDxOffTeamPokemon+@gDxOffEntityInfo+@gDxOffInfoMoves!4 1 == 19
reset
